newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Albanians sentenced for Kosovo attacks.
newsitem.headline: Albanians sentenced for Kosovo attacks.

text.p: Three ethnic Albanians were jailed in Serbia's southern province of Kosovo on Friday for involvement in bomb and gun attacks by the guerrilla Liberation Army of Kosovo, Tanjug news agency reported.
The three received terms ranging from four to 20 years as did 12 other accused tried in their absence.
The prosecution said three policemen and a women died in the attacks on police cars and military targets between 1992 and 1996.
Ethnic Albanians outnumber Serbs by nine to one in Kosovo and refuse to recognise the Serb authorities.
